parsed.evidence_quote: Cultured rat primary neurons (~2 × 106 primary hippocampal neurons for each condition) were biotinylated
we use antibody-directed proximity biotinylation to define the cell surface proteins in close proximity to the AIS cell adhesion molecule Neurofascin
Biotin tyramide (Perkin Elmer Cat# NEL749A001KT) was diluted 1:500 in a dilution buffer containing H2O2, and applied to cells for 5 min at 4 °C.
Biotin tyramide (Perkin Elmer Cat# NEL749A001KT) was diluted 1:500 in a dilution buffer
The mass spectrometry was performed on primary hippocampal neurons; while the paper uses CRISPR and KO mice for validation, the MS samples themselves are primary rat neurons.
Biotinylated proteins were isolated using streptavidin magnetic sepharose beads
